author: Jane D.
title: Great tool for team collaboration
likes: The interface is intuitive and the onboarding was smooth. Our team was up and running within a day.
dislikes: Wish there were more customization options for dashboards.
problems_solving: We needed a centralized platform for customer communication. This tool replaced three separate apps we were using before.

author: John S.
title: Solid platform with room for improvement
likes: Automation features save us hours every week. The broadcast messaging capability is very effective.
dislikes: The analytics could be more detailed. Sometimes the web app loads slowly.
problems_solving: Managing high volumes of customer conversations across a small team. The automation handles routine queries so agents can focus on complex issues.
